organizations.name: Healthcare Information and Management System (HIMS) by University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines (USTP)
organizations.details: The Healthcare Information and Management System (HIMS) is a web-based application that is designed to manage the health records of the patients. It is developed by the University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines (USTP) in Cagayan de Oro City, Misamis Oriental, Philippines.
